choices.content: Every arc of a circle is a semicircle.
A diameter is the longest chord in a circle.
Two circles with equal radii are concentric.

question.prompt: Which of the following statements is correct?

solutions.explanation: A diameter is a chord passing through the center and is the longest chord in a circle. A semicircle is a special type of arc; not every arc is a semicircle. Circles with equal radii are congruent circles and are not necessarily concentric.
solutions.title: Check the circle definitions
